thread:
sara: kicking off two-phase FK validation for orders -> users. plan: 1) deploy app pin that tolerates tentative FK, 2) add constraint NOT VALID, 3) run concurrent validate in waves, 4) flip to VALID. canary on region-us-west only.

deploybot: [deploy 3421234567] initiated by sara · commit b7f9d2e · canary region-us-west (3 pods) · steps: apply DDL (NOT VALID), rollout pin, validate waves, promote constraint. will post step status.

Code block:
```sql
ALTER TABLE orders ADD CONSTRAINT fk_orders_users FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) NOT VALID;
```

pj: what's our abort criteria / holdpoints?

sara: hold if replication lag > 1s for 5m, or 5xx error rate for orders API > 1% above baseline, or if validate job fails on any shard > 2x. fallback: we can drop FK or keep NOT VALID and stop rollout.

deploybot: canary applied FK NOT VALID on canary DBs. app pin push: api-service@3.1.0 applied (tolerates missing FK).

db-ops: starting validation wave 1 on shards 1-5 with 30m batch windows, concurrency 4. using safe-validate runner.

Code block:
```bash
./bin/safe-validate --table orders --constraint fk_orders_users --shards 1-5 --concurrency 4 --batch-size 2000
```

alek: monitoring replication + error budget. dash: https://console.internal.redwood/dashboards/mig/3421234567

release-manager: I updated release notes: https://internal/docs/releases/3421234567 — called out FK add and staged validation. pinged product for visibility.

deploybot: wave 1 complete: 0 failures on shards 1-5; ramping to wave 2 (shards 6-15) in 10m.

sara: ops please pin legacy-worker in region-us-west to 1.14 until validate finishes so there's no write path that bypasses checks.

db-ops: pinned legacy-worker. starting wave 2. ETA ~45m.

sre-rotation: reminder: paging if replication lag > 2s for >3m or if validate job retries > 4 times.

deploybot: wave 2 mid-run — one shard (10) reported timeout on chunk 7, runner auto-retried. current retry-count 1.

pj: seeing small spike in orders write latency ~120ms over baseline, not yet alarming. continue watching.

sara: decision: continue but slow down concurrency on shard 10 to 1. revert to previous concurrency if stable.

db-ops: adjusted concurrency for shard 10. continuing.

deploybot: wave 2 completed. aggregate issues: shard 10 had 3 transient timeouts, retried successfully. no data mismatches.

infra-lead: note — if we hit persistent timeouts on additional shards, we should consider short quiesce (5m) across writers to finish validation safely.

sara: agreed. we'll only quiesce if 2 more shards show persistent failures.

deploybot: preparing final promote step (mark constraint VALID). This is the critical flip. rollback hatch: `deploybot rollback 3421234567 --ddl-revert no` to drop constraint, or `deploybot rollback 3421234567 --app-unpin 3.1.0` to restore previous app behavior. Current state: FK added NOT VALID, validation passed across shards 1-15.

release-manager: are we ready to promote? any objections?

alek: observed replication lag stable ~350ms, orders 5xx at baseline. I give thumbs up.

sara: promoting to VALID in 3m. will run promote in small shard batches and keep app pinned for 1 hour post-promote.

Code block:
```sql
ALTER TABLE orders VALIDATE CONSTRAINT fk_orders_users;
```

deploybot: promote started · applying VALIDation in shard groups: 1-5,6-10,11-15. will report completion/errors.

sre-rotation: oncall alerted. standing by for paging if promote causes DB waits > 60s.

deploybot: promote completed: constraint VALID across all shards. final step: unpin app after 1h observation window. current: no rollback triggered.

pj: updating post-release notes and communicating to integrators. thanks team. :tada:

sara: closing window. will follow up with perf summary tomorrow.
